Satono Diamond watched the Japan Cup. She 
was astounded by the aggressive running of 
Tokai Teio and Kitasan Black.

Tokai Teio stated that she always strives 
to remain a challenger. Because if you 
stop challenging yourself, that's where it 
all ends.

Hearing Tokai Teio's story, Satono Diamond 
decided that she, too, wanted to keep 
being a challenger.

She resolves to challenge everything, 
forging a new chapter of history for both 
the Satono family and the Japanese 
Umamusume world.

That is what it means for Satono Diamond 
to be a "great Umamusume."
